name: Claude Code
description: Anthropic's agentic coding tool available across the Terminal CLI, VS Code/Cursor and JetBrains extensions, a Desktop app, and the web (claude.ai/code). Powered by Opus 4.8 and Sonnet 4.6 with 1M-token context, it reads, edits, and creates files across entire codebases with tool use, MCP server integration, hooks, background agents, and CI integrations.

writing-chat.summary: Claude Code provides a conversational interface for discussing code across multiple surfaces — Terminal CLI, VS Code/Cursor and JetBrains extensions, a Desktop app, and the web — with multi-turn conversations grounded in full project context.

subFeatures.name: Multi-Surface Chat Interface
subFeatures.description: Interactive conversation available in the terminal REPL, VS Code/Cursor and JetBrains extensions, a Desktop app, and the web at claude.ai/code, with streaming responses and syntax-highlighted code

subFeatures.name: Codebase-Aware Conversation
subFeatures.description: Automatically understands project structure, reads relevant files, and provides answers grounded in the actual codebase

subFeatures.name: CLAUDE.md Instructions
subFeatures.description: Project-level and user-level instruction files that customize Claude Code's behavior, coding style, and response format for every interaction

subFeatures.name: Multi-Turn Refinement
subFeatures.description: Iterative conversation within a session to refine code changes, debug issues, and explore alternatives

limitations: Context window bounded by model limits — up to 1M tokens on Opus 4.8 and Sonnet 4.6
Terminal output has no rich media rendering
Session history not persisted across separate sessions by default

pricingTiers.details: Claude Code included with usage-based limits; no free tier for Claude Code
Higher usage limits for intensive coding workflows
Pay-per-token at Sonnet 4.6 / Opus 4.8 rates; Terminal CLI and VS Code also support AWS Bedrock and Vertex AI

versionHistory.changes: Now powered by Opus 4.8 — Anthropic's most capable model — with stronger long-horizon agentic coding, fewer compactions, better tool triggering, and a default 'high' effort level
Powered by Opus 4.7 (adds an xhigh effort level) and Sonnet 4.6 with 1M-token context
General availability with agentic coding model support
Public beta launch with tool use, file editing, and terminal commands

research.summary: Claude Code can perform web searches via MCP servers and fetch documentation, though its primary research mode is codebase exploration — searching files, tracing dependencies, and understanding architecture.

subFeatures.name: Codebase Search and Exploration
subFeatures.description: Uses grep, glob, and file reading tools to search across the entire project, find definitions, trace call chains, and map architecture

subFeatures.name: MCP-Based Web Search
subFeatures.description: Connect external MCP servers (like Context7, Brave Search) to enable web search and documentation lookup from within Claude Code

limitations: No built-in web browsing — requires MCP server configuration for web access
Web search results depend on connected MCP server capabilities
Cannot access paywalled or authenticated web content
Research scope primarily code-focused, not general-purpose

pricingTiers.details: Codebase search included; web search requires MCP server setup (often free)

versionHistory.changes: MCP server support enabling external tool and data source connections
Built-in grep and glob tools for codebase search

file-analysis.summary: Claude Code reads and analyzes any file in the project directory — source code, configuration, documentation, images, PDFs, and Jupyter notebooks — with full understanding of file relationships and project structure.

subFeatures.name: Multi-Format File Reading
subFeatures.description: Read source code, JSON, YAML, Markdown, PDFs, images (multimodal), and Jupyter notebooks with structured output

subFeatures.name: Project Structure Analysis
subFeatures.description: Understands monorepo layouts, package boundaries, import graphs, and build system configurations

subFeatures.name: Git History Analysis
subFeatures.description: Read git logs, diffs, and blame information to understand code evolution and recent changes

limitations: File reading limited to local filesystem — cannot fetch remote files without MCP
Large binary files cannot be analyzed
Image analysis requires multimodal model capabilities
Very large files may be partially read due to context window limits

pricingTiers.details: Full file analysis included in all Claude Code access methods

versionHistory.changes: Added image and PDF reading support via multimodal Claude models
Text-based file reading and analysis tools

document-creation.summary: Claude Code creates documentation, README files, technical specs, and any text-based documents directly in the project filesystem. It writes files with full awareness of project context.

subFeatures.name: Documentation Generation
subFeatures.description: Generate README files, API documentation, architecture docs, and inline code comments based on codebase analysis

subFeatures.name: File Creation
subFeatures.description: Create any text-based file — Markdown, JSON, YAML, TypeScript, configuration files — directly in the project directory

limitations: Text-based output only — no PDF, DOCX, or presentation generation
Cannot create visual diagrams or charts
Document formatting limited to what the file format supports

pricingTiers.details: Document creation included in all Claude Code access methods

versionHistory.changes: File creation and editing tools for documentation and code

image-generation.summary: Claude Code does not generate images. It is a code-focused tool without any image generation capabilities.

subFeatures.name: Not Available
subFeatures.description: Claude Code is designed for code generation and editing — image generation is not part of its feature set

limitations: No image generation capability
No integration with image generation APIs
Cannot create visual assets, diagrams, or illustrations

versionHistory.changes: No image generation included

prototyping.summary: Claude Code is a powerful prototyping tool that generates, edits, and tests code across entire projects. It can scaffold new applications, implement features end-to-end, run tests, and iterate based on results.

subFeatures.name: Full-Stack Code Generation
subFeatures.description: Generate complete implementations spanning frontend, backend, database schemas, and configuration from natural language descriptions

subFeatures.name: Multi-File Editing
subFeatures.description: Make coordinated changes across dozens of files simultaneously, maintaining consistency across the entire codebase

subFeatures.name: Test-Driven Development
subFeatures.description: Write tests first, then implement code to pass them, with automatic test execution to verify correctness

subFeatures.name: Shell Command Execution
subFeatures.description: Run build commands, test suites, linters, and dev servers directly from Claude Code to verify generated code works

subFeatures.name: Git Workflow Integration
subFeatures.description: Create commits, branches, and manage git operations as part of the prototyping workflow

limitations: Code execution requires local dev environment setup
Cannot create GUI-based prototypes or interactive previews within the tool
Network-dependent operations require local connectivity
Long-running processes may need manual management

pricingTiers.details: Full prototyping capabilities with usage-based limits
Higher limits for intensive prototyping workflows

versionHistory.changes: Opus 4.8 and Sonnet 4.6 with enhanced long-horizon agentic coding and 1M-token context
Enhanced reasoning for complex multi-file refactoring tasks
Multi-file editing with bash command execution

personalization.summary: Claude Code offers deep personalization through CLAUDE.md instruction files at project, user, and global levels, plus memory files for persistent preferences and hooks for custom workflow automation.

subFeatures.name: CLAUDE.md Project Instructions
subFeatures.description: Project-level instruction file that defines coding conventions, forbidden patterns, required tools, and project-specific guidelines for all Claude Code interactions

subFeatures.name: User-Level CLAUDE.md
subFeatures.description: Personal instruction file (~/.claude/CLAUDE.md) applied across all projects for consistent personal preferences

subFeatures.name: Memory System
subFeatures.description: Claude Code can save and recall facts, preferences, and project context across sessions via memory files

subFeatures.name: Hooks
subFeatures.description: Custom scripts triggered at specific lifecycle events (pre-tool-use, post-tool-use, notification) for automated workflow customization

limitations: CLAUDE.md files must be manually maintained
Memory has storage limits and may not retain all details
Hooks require scripting knowledge to configure
No GUI for managing preferences

versionHistory.changes: Custom lifecycle hooks for pre/post tool-use automation
Persistent memory system for cross-session context
Project and user-level instruction files for customization

persistent-context.summary: Claude Code maintains persistent context through CLAUDE.md instruction files, memory files, git history, and project-level configuration that carries across sessions and team members.

subFeatures.name: CLAUDE.md as Living Context
subFeatures.description: Version-controlled instruction files that serve as persistent project context, shared across all team members who use Claude Code

subFeatures.name: Memory Files
subFeatures.description: Persistent memory storage for user preferences, project decisions, and accumulated context that survives across sessions

subFeatures.name: Git-Based Context
subFeatures.description: Automatically reads git history, recent commits, and branch context to understand ongoing work

subFeatures.name: Session Resume
subFeatures.description: Resume previous conversation context using the --resume flag to continue interrupted work

limitations: Memory files have size constraints
Session history not automatically persisted beyond recent conversations
No cloud-synced context across different machines without git
Context window limits constrain how much persistent context can be loaded per interaction

versionHistory.changes: Resume previous sessions with --resume and --continue flags
Persistent memory system across sessions
Project-level persistent instructions

agents.summary: Claude Code is a fully agentic coding system that autonomously plans, executes, and verifies multi-step coding tasks. It offers an /agents dashboard for running many full sessions in parallel, background agents, an Agent SDK, routines/scheduled jobs, CI integrations, and Slack-driven PRs.

subFeatures.name: Autonomous Task Execution
subFeatures.description: Independently plans multi-step coding tasks, selects tools, reads files, writes code, runs tests, and iterates until the task is complete

subFeatures.name: Agents Dashboard and Background Agents
subFeatures.description: The /agents dashboard runs several full Claude Code sessions in parallel as background agents, with status tracking and result review

subFeatures.name: Agent SDK
subFeatures.description: SDK for building custom agents on top of Claude Code's agentic runtime

subFeatures.name: Routines and Scheduled Tasks
subFeatures.description: Cron-style recurring jobs (e.g., morning PR reviews, weekly dependency audits) that run on Anthropic-managed infrastructure

subFeatures.name: CI/CD Integrations
subFeatures.description: GitHub Actions and GitLab CI/CD integration to auto-review PRs and triage issues in pipelines; @Claude on a Slack thread returns a PR

subFeatures.name: Remote Control and Dispatch
subFeatures.description: Continue sessions from a phone and trigger runs via Telegram, Discord, iMessage, or webhooks; /ultrareview runs cloud-based parallel code review

subFeatures.name: Tool Use Framework
subFeatures.description: Built-in tools for file operations (Read, Write, Edit), shell commands (Bash), search (Grep, Glob), and external integrations (MCP)

subFeatures.name: Headless Mode
subFeatures.description: Run Claude Code non-interactively in CI/CD pipelines, scripts, and automation workflows with structured output

limitations: Agent operates within local filesystem permissions
No built-in sandboxing for local sessions — executes with user's system permissions
Long-running agentic loops consume significant token usage
Complex multi-repo operations require manual configuration

pricingTiers.details: Full agentic capabilities with usage-based limits; no free tier
Higher limits for intensive agentic workflows

versionHistory.version: Agents Dashboard, Routines, CI and Slack
versionHistory.changes: /agents dashboard with background agents, Agent SDK, routines/scheduled jobs, GitHub/GitLab CI integration, Slack-driven PRs, and /ultrareview
Agent tool for spawning sub-agents and parallel task execution
Non-interactive execution for CI/CD and automation
Model Context Protocol server support for extensible tool use
Agentic coding with autonomous tool use loops

connectors.summary: Claude Code connects to external services through MCP (Model Context Protocol) servers, enabling integration with databases, APIs, cloud services, and developer tools from within the coding workflow.

subFeatures.name: MCP Server Ecosystem
subFeatures.description: Connect to any MCP-compatible server for external data sources, tools, and service integrations (GitHub, databases, search engines, monitoring)

subFeatures.name: IDE Extensions
subFeatures.description: Mature VS Code/Cursor extension (inline diffs, @-mentions, plan review) and JetBrains plugin that bring Claude Code directly into the IDE

subFeatures.name: Git and GitHub Integration
subFeatures.description: Native git operations and GitHub CLI integration for branch management, PR creation, and code review workflows

subFeatures.name: Chrome Integration
subFeatures.description: Connect to Chrome to inspect and debug live web apps from within Claude Code

limitations: MCP servers require manual setup and configuration
Some IDE extension features differ from the full CLI
No native integration with project management tools without MCP
MCP ecosystem is still maturing — not all services have servers

pricingTiers.details: MCP, IDE, and Chrome integrations included; some MCP servers may have their own costs

versionHistory.changes: Debug live web apps from within Claude Code
VS Code/Cursor extension with inline diffs, @-mentions, and plan review; JetBrains plugin
Model Context Protocol server support
Native git operations from Claude Code

dictation.summary: Claude Code is a text-based terminal tool with no voice input or dictation capabilities.

subFeatures.name: Not Available
subFeatures.description: Claude Code operates entirely through text input in the terminal — no voice or speech-to-text support

limitations: No voice input or dictation support
Terminal interface is text-only
No speech-to-text or audio processing capabilities

versionHistory.changes: No voice capabilities included
